title: Maduro's 'tiger' with designer fashion tastes: Who is Venezuela's VP Delcy Rodriguez?
summary: Hours after Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro was captured in an audacious US raid, Vice President Delcy Rodriguez insisted he remains the Latin American country’s only leader. In a televised speech, Rodriguez, who is also finance and oil minister, called for calm. Rodriguez denounced Maduro's kidnapping and vowed to defend Venezuela's resources.
